columns.label: To test at the first stop

cells.n: Does a sample turn into a store sale?
Do they keep buying back home?

notes: How we attribute. Every touchpoint issues a code: the cup code at drink stations, the pack code on co-branded packs and the store voucher for stub swaps, each carrying the city and the show. Fans scan to get a store voucher in our mini program, redeem it in our stores or convenience stores, and each redemption traces back to a show and a touchpoint. Then we check whether people who scanned buy again within 30 days. The last step matters most: comparing show cities with similar cities that had no show, on co-branded and store sales, tells us whether the extra sales came from the concert. The table says what each code can tell us and what the first stop still has to test. The central question is whether a free sample at the venue turns into a store purchase. No peer has published a figure for that step.
